result.summary: W0_VERIFY (persist): defined deterministic cancel and undo EVIDENCE requirements for G3 vertical slice without implementing G4 persistence. Cancel-before-complete means no canonical durable mutation (preview-only teardown). Undo is a compensating-mutation receipt stub that never erases history. Entity hash / append-only log / save-reload deferred to G4-001.

in_scope: Evidence field contracts for complete / cancel / undo smoke exports
Semantic definition of no canonical durable mutation on cancel
Undo as compensating mutation (not history erase) for G3 stub path
Pointers to existing G2 pipeline + manifestation cancel invariants

Product code, contracts, architecture, tasks.json edits

canonical_durable_mutation.meaning: A successful World Commit service mutation that advances authoritative world state: new_world_revision > old_world_revision, entity_ids assigned, artifact_hashes recorded, and (online) outbox event world.mutation_committed published. Sole mutator is world_commit_service (ARCHITECTURE_LOCK + commit_policy).
not_canonical: AGM Decision soft effects (dialogue, quest objective text, mood/relationship deltas within executor caps)
Schema-valid World Prompt proposals and preview geometry
commit_request handoff stubs and synthetic commit_receipt_stub with status rejected/policy
Local UI/session pipeline records (pipeline_stage, confirmation pending)

authority: AIdle_Openworld_Blueprint_v1.1/05_Authority_and_Multiplayer.md: Undo creates a compensating mutation; history is not erased
contracts/commit/commit_receipt.schema.json: receipts are outcomes; no erase API
required_meaning_for_G3: Undo NEVER deletes, mutates-in-place, or redacts a prior complete/commit receipt. Prior receipt_id remains referenceable.
Undo is modeled as a NEW compensating request + receipt (or export stub of that shape) that reverses effects of a prior successful complete path.
Compensating request uses mutation_class = compensating, a NEW request_id (idempotency key), and links to the prior commit via prior_receipt_id and/or prior_request_id and/or compensated_entity_ids.

G3 vertical slice: live World Commit is NOT invoked. Undo smoke produces a compensating receipt STUB with durable_mutation_applied false (or equivalent stub flag), proving shape and non-erase semantics without G4 log append.

If G3 complete path itself is only a handoff stub (no real commit), undo may still emit a compensating stub that references the complete-path export receipt_id; smoke must assert history_preserved == true and no prior receipt file deleted.
Event intent (documentary for G3, not required bus publish): world.mutation_compensated would carry new world_revision only when a real commit service applies compensation (G4+).
forbidden_on_undo_path: Deleting or overwriting complete/cancel export files as 'undo'
Setting prior receipt status to cancelled retroactively
Silent client-side entity delete without a compensating receipt record
Claiming G4 save/reload hash equality in G3 (deferred)
